overview: Professional business website for Krishna Plastic, a retail plastic products store in Takrohi Market, Lucknow. Features a vibrant Indian retail aesthetic with hero banner, product categories, about us, gallery, and contact sections.
features: Hero banner with CTA buttons (Call Now, View Products, Visit Store)
8 product category cards with responsive grid layout
About Us section highlighting customer satisfaction and quality
Why Choose Us section with 5 key differentiators
Contact section with Call and WhatsApp buttons and map placeholder
Sticky navigation with mobile hamburger menu
